# SnapLoad — Universal Video Downloader

> SnapLoad is a fast, privacy-focused online web application for downloading videos from TikTok and Instagram in 1080p HD or 4K quality, as well as extracting MP3 audio tracks directly without requiring registration or account setup.

## Key Links
- [SnapLoad Web App](https://snaploaddownload.com/): Official SnapLoad Universal Video Downloader.
- [TikTok No Watermark Downloader](https://snaploaddownload.com/tiktok-downloader): Download TikTok videos in HD without watermark.
- [TikTok MP3 Sound Extractor](https://snaploaddownload.com/tiktok-mp3-downloader): Extract 320kbps MP3 audio tracks directly from TikTok.
- [Instagram Reels Downloader](https://snaploaddownload.com/instagram-downloader): Download Instagram Reels & video clips.
- [YouTube Shorts Downloader](https://snaploaddownload.com/youtube-shorts-downloader): Download YouTube Shorts in 1080p HD or MP3 audio.
- [MP3 Audio Converter](https://snaploaddownload.com/mp3-downloader): Extract high-bitrate MP3 audio from videos.
- [Free Video Downloader Widget](https://snaploaddownload.com/widget): Embed SnapLoad video downloader widget on external blogs & websites.
- [SnapLoad Tutorials & Guides](https://snaploaddownload.com/guides): Step-by-step guides for video downloading, MP3 conversion, and social media media saving.
- [Guide: Download TikTok Without Watermark](https://snaploaddownload.com/guides/how-to-download-tiktok-without-watermark): Tutorial on downloading clean TikTok HD videos.
- [Guide: Save Instagram Reels HD](https://snaploaddownload.com/guides/how-to-save-instagram-reels-hd): Tutorial on saving Instagram Reels to camera roll.
- [Guide: YouTube Shorts Downloader](https://snaploaddownload.com/guides/how-to-download-youtube-shorts-hd): Tutorial on downloading YouTube Shorts videos & MP3 audio.
- [Guide: TikTok Photo Slideshow Downloader](https://snaploaddownload.com/guides/how-to-download-tiktok-slideshow-photos): Tutorial on downloading TikTok carousel photos.
- [Guide: Save Instagram Stories Anonymously](https://snaploaddownload.com/guides/how-to-save-instagram-stories-anonymously): Tutorial on downloading Instagram stories privately.


## Key Capabilities & Features
- **TikTok Downloader**: Download TikTok videos without watermark in HD MP4 format.
- **Instagram Downloader**: Download Instagram Reels, video posts, and IGTV clips.
- **MP3 Audio Converter**: Extract high-bitrate MP3 audio tracks directly from video links.
- **Lightning Fast Direct Stream**: Direct video streaming with zero server-side storage.
- **100% Free & Private**: No registration, no cookies, no personal data collection.

## Supported URL Patterns
- TikTok: `https://www.tiktok.com/@username/video/123456789...` or `https://vm.tiktok.com/...`
- Instagram: `https://www.instagram.com/reel/...`, `https://www.instagram.com/p/...`

## Technical Details
- Frontend Framework: React + TypeScript + Vite + TailwindCSS.
- API Endpoints: REST API for video metadata extraction (`/api/info`) and direct media stream (`/api/download`).

## Terms & Usage Guidelines
SnapLoad is built for personal archival and fair-use content downloads. Users are responsible for complying with content copyright regulations.
